name: Danton
source:
“Anyway, don’t worry over it all by yourself.  I can’t do anything to help you, but if you need to talk, I’ll listen as much as you want.”

Born in France.
Hobby: Cooking
Likes: Food
Dislikes: Minor Details

A French lawyer. He’s the type to jump right into things all fired up, forcefully dragging everyone around him along for the ride. It seems like he doesn’t think things through, but he’s intent on “doing things his own way”. Cheerful and frank, he’s warm and softhearted towards the circumstances of others. An acquaintance of Robespierre, he feels like he can’t leave him alone by himself.
